This is an outrageous attack on our sovereignty. Obviously, Israel controls our government. Anyone saying otherwise is purposely dumb or malicious. It is not within a country mile of normal for one country to have litmus test that you have to be loyal to another country. Insane.

DHS is now requiring loyalty pledges to Israel in order to get green cards. If you have criticized Israel in social media or just attended a pro-Palestinian protest, you can be denied because you have been disloyal to Israel. It applies this test to no other country.

Imagine someone comes to your house and says Israel was promised it 3,000 years ago. So, you’re going to have to leave. If you don’t, you’re an antisemite. Since antisemites are terrorists who are going to kill us all, we’re going to have to kill you first - to protect ourselves!
I remember when people elected Trump to build a ballroom.

Now, bullshit reports have begun about how JD Vance is privately, secretly against the war. And how he’s questioning it behind the scenes. Leaked by? Vance staffers! This is admission that the war is going disastrously and Vance has to pretend to be against it to save his career.

Meanwhile, the grotesque liars in our national media are pretending that this land grab is self-defense. Every time Israel attacks, our media pretends Israel had to do it and it's all the Arabs' fault. They don't do news at all, they just do Israeli propagdna disguised as news.

Your tax dollars are funding these sick terrorists invading all their neighbors and stealing their land. They have destroyed dozens of villages, including Christian ones. They murdered a priest who was trying to help wounded Christians. They say they're taking southern Lebanon.

This is the deadliest day in Lebanon since Israel invaded. 14 civilians killed. Netanyahu said they have right to violate the ceasefire. He thinks they are above the law. Their Defense Minister said soon, "a fire will break out and burn the cedars of Lebanon.” Obvious terrorists.

Iran never had a nuclear weapons program. Obama's deal ended their nuclear program entirely. Israel was desperate for US to get out of that deal, precisely because their nuclear program has always been the FAKE justification for the regime change war they wanted all along.

If some extremist branch of Islam said they had a right to all of Israel, or all of Holland, no one would take that seriously. Why should we have to listen to their beliefs? Same applies to this interpretation of Judaism. But our press makes it seem like it's a legitimate point.

Israel says they have a religious right to the holy land. Most Christians do not agree with that interpretation. No Muslim believes that. Even a lot of Jews don't believe that. Why do the rest of us have to give credence to this point from a tiny minority of religious zealots?

Israel's supporters will not refute those facts because they are indisputable. Instead, they'll say you shouldn't care about those issues, you should only care about the person telling you those facts - they should be attacked as an antisemite and never allowed to speak again!
